budget._note: 45.0 not the plan's 5.0: the 2026-08-20 five-partition calibration measured $5.04 for 15.1% of the partition tokens plus a fixed $4.15 narrative pass, projecting a $38-79 bracket for a full VS Code run. A 5.0 ceiling would truncate every refresh after roughly five partitions. Dollars are API-equivalent units reported by the claude CLI, metered against the owner's Claude Max subscription (no API key is billed; standing decision until deliberately changed). See docs/publication/ENRICHMENT-ENGINE.md section 2.

enrichment._note: min_rounds 1 is the Wave 1 forced-iteration decision: on the first subjects the determination runs an improvement round even when it believes the map is done, with a genuine reasoned target, so the tuning that later decides 'iterate or not' is learned rather than guessed. A binding is 'source:model'; 'source:auto' leaves the model unpinned so that source routes the call itself. See docs/publication/ENRICHMENT-ENGINE.md sections 2 and 3.
